fields.name: image
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Choose a wide image with space for text on the left. Optional; the banner uses a dark background when omitted.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alternative Text
fields.description: Describe meaningful imagery. Leave empty when the image is decorative.

fields.name: heading_eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Optional short label above the heading, such as 01 Infrastructure & Hardware.

fields.name: heading_titleType
fields.label: Heading Level
fields.description: Use H1 only when this is the page's main heading; otherwise choose the appropriate level.

fields.name: details_category
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: Optional metadata below the heading, such as Article or Insights.

fields.name: details_date
fields.label: Display Date
fields.description: Optional date in your preferred display format, such as March 2026.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Call-to-action Destination
fields.description: Optional page link or external URL. Supply link text as well.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Call-to-action Text
fields.description: Use descriptive text, such as Explore Infrastructure & Hardware.
